gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-kannada: Tall, squared-off lowercase with terminals that stop well short of the stem keeps this plain sans feeling modern. Anek Kannada trails behind the heavy, commanding Impact Label, and that jump in weight is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching the capitals, and its curves stay open instead of curling shut. And beneath the heavy Impact Label, whole paragraphs of it would read smoothly and without fuss.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-malayala: Impact Label hits hard, each letter standing alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding. Then Anek Malayalam, a plain sans with caps barely above its lowercase, reads cleanly down a long column.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-odia: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, every letter set apart like a bead on a rod. Yet Anek Odia, a sans-serif whose rounds stay unlatched and capitals barely clear lowercase, is the quiet strength here.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-tamil: Big, round lowercase bowls give Anek Tamil a modern feel. Its half-unwrapped curves let this sans-serif move smoothly through paragraph after paragraph, while Impact Label stays heavy and commanding above.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-telugu: Each letter of Impact Label stands alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding. Anek Telugu, a sans with wide, tall bowls and unlatched rounds, sets a clean and approachable rhythm across a full page.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anuphan: Impact Label brings heavy, commanding letters that each stand alone like beads on a rod. Anuphan, a sans with big round bowls and open curves, does the opposite job: carrying text cleanly where the heading only shouts.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-arimo: Neutral by design, Arimo stands tall with a high mean line. Spacious gaps in its rounded letters keep this sans-serif easy on the eye through paragraphs, while Impact Label hammers the point home above.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-armata: Heavy type meets spacious text: Armata, a sans with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, keeps wide gaps between characters. Impact Label does the commanding while Armata gives text room.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-athiti: Approachable and contemporary, Athiti gives every s a see-through gap and cuts its lines to a single width. Against heavy, commanding Impact Label, that single-width line stands out sharply.
